rapid_ip_country_change.instructions: Do the two latest successful sign-ins show a rapid change between distant IP countries? Use only the geo fields. IP country describes network egress. Evaluate only this signal and use a probability near 0.5 when the required evidence is missing.

criteria.true: Both IP countries are known and far apart, such as AE and DE. At most 30 minutes elapsed and both anonymizer values are none_detected.
criteria.false: The IP country matches, more than 30 minutes elapsed, or a reported VPN or proxy makes the country jump ambiguous.

unusual_login_hour.instructions: Is the current sign-in at an unusual hour for this customer? Use only the time fields. Compare hours in the customer timezone using the supplied circular distance. Evaluate only this signal and use a probability near 0.5 when the distance is unavailable or fewer than five prior successful sign-ins are available.

criteria.true: At least five prior successes are available and the current hour is at least four hours from the nearest observed hour.
criteria.false: At least five prior successes are available and the current hour is less than four hours from the nearest observed hour.

new_login_device.instructions: Is the successful sign-in on a device first seen by the bank within the preceding 24 hours? Use only the device fields. Evaluate only this signal and use a probability near 0.5 when the recorded device age is missing.

criteria.true: The device age at sign-in is between zero and 1440 minutes inclusive.
criteria.false: The device age at sign-in exceeds 1440 minutes.

recent_credential_change.instructions: Was a password reset or an MFA change recorded within the 60 minutes before the successful sign-in? Use only the credentials fields. Evaluate only this signal. If neither event meets the window and the event log is incomplete, use a probability near 0.5. In a complete log a null age means no recorded event.

criteria.true: At least one of the password reset and MFA change ages is between zero and 60 minutes inclusive.
criteria.false: The event log is complete and both event ages are either null or greater than 60 minutes.

failed_login_burst.instructions: Did at least three failed sign-ins for this account precede the current successful sign-in by at most one hour? Use only the failures fields. Evaluate only this signal and use a probability near 0.5 when the count is missing.

criteria.true: The account has three or more failed sign-ins in the preceding hour.
criteria.false: The observed count of failed sign-ins in the preceding hour is zero, one, or two.
